summary: Anthropic explains that future Claude models will add an imperceptible watermark to generated text (using Google DeepMind's SynthID-Text method) and C2PA content credentials to generated files, in order to comply with the EU AI Act's Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content.

practices.reason: The watermarking scheme provides a new way to probabilistically verify whether text was AI-generated, relevant to trust/measurement practice, but the detection instrument itself is not yet available to outside teams.
